---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a scoped improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What operator or contributor problem would this solve?

## Proposed change

Describe the smallest useful change and how it preserves the frozen v0.1
contracts.

## Current behavior

What happens today?

## Expected behavior

What should happen instead?

## Environment

Which Sentinel version, OS, deployment mode, and telemetry source are involved?

## Evidence

Include a reproducible example, safe logs, or user observations. Do not include
tokens, credentials, private traffic, PCAP contents, or personal paths.

## Alternatives and scope

What alternatives were considered? Does this require changes to the model,
target, data pipeline, or operating policy?
